UK Woman Arrested for Allegedly Stabbing Boyfriend to Death in Thailand

A 21-year-old British woman has been arrested in Thailand after allegedly fatally stabbing her boyfriend, who was a weed farmer. The incident occurred in a luxury rental home in the Pattaya area. Local media reports suggest that the woman appeared to be heavily intoxicated by cannabis at the time of the incident.
